title: Mini Venezuelan Pudding
description: A classic Venezuelan dessert, reimagined in mini form. These bite-sized puddings are rich, creamy, and utterly delicious.

ingredients.name: Light Cream
ingredients.notes: heavy cream or half-and-half work too

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the pudding, cream, sugar, vanilla extract, and salt. Whisk until smooth and well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Just before serving, use a cookie scoop or spoon to portion out the pudding into mini cups or ramekins.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar or a drizzle of caramel sauce if desired.
